translations.HelpText: ❓ Help nAlbum keeps photos and videos in shared albums. Invite people with a link or by forwarding a message from them. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Roles 👤 Members view the album. 🛠 Managers also add and remove files and invite people. 👑 The owner controls everything. ⌨️ Commands /menu – menu /albums – albums /new – new album /join CODE – join with a code /language – language /privacy – privacy /cancel – cancel the current action /help – help

translations.PrivacyPolicy: 🔒 Privacy policy What the bot stores • Your Telegram user ID, first and last name, when you first and last used the bot, and your language choice. • Albums: titles, Telegram file IDs of added photos, videos and songs, who has access and with which role, and invite links. The files themselves stay on Telegram's servers – the bot never downloads them. • Viewing statistics per album and user (views and page flips) and anonymous totals. What it doesn't store The content of your messages, your username, phone number or contacts. Photos and videos you send while adding media are removed from the chat once saved. Who sees what • The owner and managers of an album you belong to see your name and role in its member list. • Bot administrators see aggregate statistics and album titles, can remove albums and can send announcements to all users. Statistics never show user IDs or names. • Your data is not sold or shared with third parties. Telegram handles messages under its own privacy policy. Your choices • You can leave any album at any time. Deleting an album removes its media references, members, invite links and statistics. • To have all your data deleted, contact the bot operator. The bot is open source: https://github.com/Severnbli/nAlbum
